manifest.label: additional-can-policy-v1
manifest.policy: Apply the SAME predeclared four-closure bank to all22newCanepisodes: fixed base offset/elbow seed, open verticalapproach, local.8rad/sreferencecap, support40deg with2mmextra descent. Original contactphysics; complete sourceclock. Episode-specific selection is only by the existing physical gates+independent actuator replay; no geometry/object or threshold tuning from this batch.
